The campaign counted it a survivor because validation/v2/mutation.py:814 lists only T11a and T11b as the kill set of `findings`; T12b is wired to `finding_id` (:813), whose own default it was written for ('Pins ... finding_id [2]'), and its second test is the one that also pins the record's. The audit's grep ('get(category)/[category] over aisef2, validation') did not look in tests/. The id itself is not affected by the mutant (finding_id uses its own `comment.get('category') or 'other'`, review_ocr.py:61). Measured here: the mutant applied to a copy of the 289885e tree and run against 26 test modules - 231 tests of 20 (review_ocr, A10, A11, T10a-d, T11a-b, T12a-b, defects_ocr, defects_ocrz, R07, and the round-3 detail_product, detail_failclosed, detail_rv_finderfiles, detail_artifact, detail_statement, detail_model), test_v21_review_chain (18 tests, 3 RealBinary skips) and 80 tests of 5 more (T13a, kills_adapters, r3_client_stream, T14b, T26a): ONE TEST FAILS (tests.v2.test_v21_kills3_T12b.FindingIdWithoutCategory.test_the_finding_carries_that_id_and_reports_the_category_other).

entries.grounds: The record's 'source' value at review_ocr.py:156 loses its 'ocr ' prefix: 'v1.12.12' instead of 'ocr v1.12.12'. Where a finding record lands at 289885e: (a) RUN.json sessions[].findings through review_verify.redacted(found, secrets) (aisef2/app/adapters.py:150; run.py:497, :506) - as in b5c2457; (b) NEW in round 3: the artifact review-findings/<story>.<attempt>.<index>.json (adapters.py:142-143 -> review_verify.preserve, review_verify.py:408-440), the whole record, whose sha256 and size are in the gate row's statement (`artifact`) and in EVIDENCE.json (run.py:298-300). The only reader of the artifact is review_verify.artifact_problems (review_verify.py:443-492, called at verify.py:164): `format`, `story_id`, `finding.id`. The kernel's readers of a finding's fields are reproducer_contract (review_verify.py:91-123: reproducer, id, summary), anchor (:214), blocks (:254-257: severity_of), detail (:344-405: id, severity_of, summary, reproducer) and adapters.py:134-148 (reproducer, id, blocking). `source`, `category`, `in_scope`, `path`, `start_line` are read by none of them. The label's information is also carried by the artifact's own `session` key (the finder's stream name, `S1.reviewer.<n>.jsonl`: adapters.py:143, :248), whose first line is {'type': 'ocr_started', 'finder': 'ocr v1.12.12'} (adapters.py:225-226; the stream is listed in EVIDENCE.json, run.py:299), and by RUN.json sessions[].finder (adapters.py:249). The version alone still names the pinned release.
